text:
sara-recruiter: Need quick guidance — two agency contractors flying in Thurs for back-to-back onsites. Agency says they want us to pre-pay flights. Can we do an exception for advances?

emma-peopleops: Short: we can, but only via a hiring travel advance workflow. Contractors are not automatically eligible. We'll need the advance form + approvals.

sara-recruiter: Where's the form and timeline? Hiring manager wants to book by tomorrow.

emma-peopleops: Form: https://intranet.redwood/corp/expenses/hiring-advance. Approvals required: hiring manager + People Ops. Finance needs vendor paperwork if paying the individual (W-9/COI) or procurement handles agency invoice. ACH lead time is ~48 hours after approvals.

max-hiringops: If the agency invoices us, procurement will pay the invoice and no advance is necessary. Sara, ask agency if they can invoice. If not, we proceed with advance.

jon-finance: FYI finance constraints: max hiring-travel advance $1,000 per person w/out VP signoff. Reconcile within 5 business days post-travel or we offset against next billing. Attach estimates and project_code when reconciling.

expense-bot: Policy excerpt: per-diem capped at $75/day domestic, hotel cap $250/night without approval, alcohol not reimbursable. See full policy: https://intranet.redwood/corp/expenses/policy.

emma-peopleops: Copy/paste checklist for the advance request (helps avoid back-and-forth):

```\nHiring Travel Advance - minimum required fields:
- Requestor name & team
- Contractor full name + agency
- Business purpose (onsite interviews)
- Travel dates
- Itemized estimate: airfare, hotel, ground
- Preferred payment method (ACH/check)
- Hiring manager approver
- Procurement/PO if agency to invoice
```

max-hiringops: Also note — if we issue an advance to a contractor (not agency), we need vendor intake: tax form + banking. That can add 1-2 business days, so prefer agency invoice if possible.

sara-recruiter: Told agency to invoice if possible. They replied they can but require the PR before the travel dates. I'll submit the advance form in case procurement timing slips. Estimates: Contractor A $485 (flight+1 night), Contractor B $295 (flight only).

emma-peopleops: Thanks. If you submit the form, tick the "fallback advance" box so finance knows it's contingency. We'll cap at $500 each to simplify.

jon-finance: When reconciling, tag expenses: project_code: ["hiring-events"] and cost_center: ["recruiting"]. If payments go to agency, link invoice number in the PR to avoid duplicate payments.

sara-recruiter: Submitted form and attached agency email. @max-hiringops can you kick off the PR if agency invoices?

max-hiringops: On it. Opening PR now and pinging vendor. If procurement confirms invoice timing, we'll cancel the advances.

emma-peopleops: Quick reminder to contractors: keep itemized receipts (not card slips), submit within 5 business days after travel. Unspent advance funds must be returned. No seat upgrades without pre-approval.

sara-recruiter: Noted. Thanks all.

expense-bot: Created ADV ticket ADV-2026-349 and PR ticket PR-2026-88. Advance ceiling set to $500/person pending approvals. Reconcile deadline set to 5 business days after travel end.
